# CBMQS Deployment Matrix

The Chicago Bare-Metal Qualification Standard v1
(arcus `docs/jira/v26.11.3/cbmqs-standard.md`), rendered from the RDF graph
(`packs/cscb-pack/ontology.ttl`). Every threshold is in its exact receipted

Source of truth: the graph; this table is a projection, never a second

a skip is loud.
